messages:
Olivia Park: Heads up folks — legal wants the v1->v2 deprecation banner live this Friday. Need a tiny migration note, snippet swaps, and a checklist for teams that own public SDKs. Can we split tasks quickly?

Marcus Grant: I can swap the Java + .NET snippets. Plan: keep "before/after" short and put streaming differences in a collapsible section.

Tess Nguyen: I'll update the central migration doc and add a short troubleshooting FAQ (common gotchas: param rename, embed dims, webhook payload change).

Olivia Park: Great. Marcus, include a one-liner about model alias mapping (old -> new) with a link to the model-swap doc. Keep the alias table to 3 rows.

Marcus Grant: Will do. Example rows: rwd-tiny -> redwood-tiny-v2, rwd-base -> redwood-base-v2, rwd-large -> redwood-large-v2.

Ravi Shah: Deploy-bot, can CI create a smoke template for docs PRs so QA can run the minimal migration smoke tests on merge?

Deploy-bot: deploy-checks/1791238888: created job template `docs-migrate-smoke-179123`. Assign to PR merger.

Tess Nguyen: I'll add a PR checklist comment in each docs/sdks PR: owner, reviewer, smoke-test id, and a brief smoke-test result summary. That saved time last deprecation.

Olivia Park: One more: make sure SDK READMEs show both old v1 snippet and new v2 snippet side-by-side for 72 hours after redirect, then remove v1 snippet. Label PRs `deprecate/v1` so we can find them.

Marcus Grant: Ack. I'll land snippets this afternoon and tag Tess for review.

Tess Nguyen: Thanks. If anyone finds embedded links to `/v1/` paths, paste them into your PR comment so infra can add redirects. We'll consolidate before the banner goes live. :white_check_mark:
